claim: Audio and classification stay in the browser
where: landing facts, consent, footer, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; record with fake microphone while capturing every request; assert every request is same-origin

sandbox: fresh /demo context; start without consent; assert the request is blocked and focus moves to consent

where: record control, method, privacy page, README

sandbox: fresh /demo context; wait for service-worker control; set context offline; reload; assert demo data and offline state
